w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gina just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering Spool gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Ad Break mauled Vedika (-49 health) over 4 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Big." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/12/5), with 3 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 29 → 24 · capped · Craft 15 · Talk 15 · Explore 31 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Diana Osei ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,089 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
